The first public release of **cob-portal-mcp**, the MCP server for the [Call O Buzz portal](https://portal.callobuzz.com).
An AI agent reads tasks and sends drafts and notes. A person approves every draft in the portal.

## Install

```bash
claude mcp add cob-portal \
  --env COB_PORTAL_URL=https://portal.callobuzz.com \
  --env COB_PORTAL_KEY=cob_your_key_here \
  -- npx -y cob-portal-mcp
```

Make the key on the portal Profile page, under API keys. Claude Desktop and other clients: see the
[README](https://github.com/callobuzz/cob-portal-mcp#install-in-one-command).

## Security

- The key goes over https only. Plain http is refused, except `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]`.
- A redirect is never followed, so the key is never sent on to another address.
- The server tells the agent that task text and notes are data written by people, never instructions.
- `zod` 4.6.7, and the build tool `esbuild` 0.28.1 or newer. `pnpm audit` finds no known vulnerabilities.

## Added

- Task categories: `list_categories`, and `category` on `list_tasks`, `get_task`, `list_templates` and drafts.
- A main task with sub-tasks in one `draft_tasks` batch: `ref` and `parentRef`, or `parentId` for a task that already
  exists. `doneWhen` lines on a draft.
- The `plan_growth_work` prompt: plans business work as main tasks with sub-tasks.

## Changed

- MIT licence, public repository and npm package. `npx -y github:callobuzz/cob-portal-mcp` also works.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/callobuzz/cob-portal-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
